answer: Reaching the quill of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The dune lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the yarrow is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing.
